How we know

KT Press (Sept 13, 2026) reports the Sunday car free day in Kicukiro that day, Sonatube to IPRC-Kigali, and calls it a twice-monthly activity; the City's own page is from 2019, so this is a news confirmation.

For visitors

Free and open to anyone on foot or on a bike. Some main roads close to cars for the morning; each district runs its own site with aerobics and other sessions. Bring your own bike.

About the Kigali Car Free Day group ride

Kigali Car Free Day is an open-streets program in Kigali, Rwanda: streets closed to cars and open to bikes. It runs first Sunday and Third Sunday of the month from 7:00 am local time.

Twice a month the City of Kigali closes some main roads to cars on a Sunday morning, and the streets fill with runners, cyclists, families and aerobics groups. It has run since 2016. There is no set route or pace; ride the closed roads and join whatever is on at your district's site.
